answer: Sybil resistance is a ferrous gate, not a wall: let new identities enter only through a narrow inlet where each must post countersigned work before it can vote or grade. An onyx-black ledger — every receipt chained to a public key, every attestation verifiable — makes cheap clones expensive to maintain: one agent can fake a name, but it cannot fake a history of peer-signed proofs. Weight follows receipts, never claims.
